summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The Tradr 2X Long CEG Daily ETF (CEGX) is an exchange-traded fund that mostly invests in utilities equity. The fund provides 2x exposure, less fees and expenses, to the daily price movement of Constellation Energy Corp. stock. CEGX was launched on Jul 10, 2025 and is issued by Tradr.
